title: Final editorial-profile corpus enrichment and integrity review

selectedGap.reason: This production corpus segment selects 18 of 18 currently eligible published organizations for comprehensive, review-first editorial-profile refresh without automatic activation or publication.

guardrailNotes: Candidates remain private until separate human Admin Review and Publish decisions; this run does not mutate canonical atlas records.
Identity, successor, Canadian-nexus, entity-kind, duplicate and insolvency conflicts remain typed research_required dispositions rather than being padded into unsafe dossier candidates.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: Ferreol Technologies can update its name to SCALIUM+ (formerly Ferreol Technologies), add Scandium Canada ownership, and date the CSA-backed current activity. Evidence: 7 durable sources from Scandium Canada, SCALIUM+ and the Canadian Space Agency establish the acquisition, product formats, Quebec City footprint, contact and August 17, 2026 amendment. Mission/Public Need read: the existing Arctic Domain Awareness relationship remains unchanged; alloy formulation, thick plate, powder and wire are enabling material premises, not mission proof. Unknowns: aerospace qualification, production capacity, flight heritage, legal corporate rename and a named customer remain unverified. Reviewer action: verify the name and current activity wording, then accept the editorial profile only if the SCALIUM+ successor framing and C$348,750 project boundary are clear.
reviewWarnings: The Canadian Space Agency work is a materials scale-up and proof-of-concept contribution, not evidence of procurement, flight qualification, delivery or in-service adoption.
No public source establishes aerospace qualification, production capacity, flight heritage or a named customer for the thick-plate application.
The acquisition sources introduce SCALIUM+ as the subsidiary and brand, but a formal legal rename of 9480-3798 Québec inc. was not independently confirmed.

duplicateCheck.note: Production organizations and current review candidates were checked by slug, name, legal name, alias and website domain; no separate SCALIUM+ organization record exists.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: Scandium Canada reports that the current operating brand is SCALIUM+ while preserving Ferreol Technologies as the predecessor identity.
Scandium Canada describes the acquired Quebec materials business and SCALIUM+ brand as developing aluminum-scandium alloy formats for commercial and aerospace applications.
Scandium Canada says it acquired all issued and outstanding shares of 9480-3798 Québec inc., operating as Ferreol Technologies, and introduced SCALIUM+ as its subsidiary and brand.
The SCALIUM+ catalogue markets aluminum-scandium alloy in multiple formats, while the CSA award identifies the thick-plate aerospace work as scale-up, characterization and proof of concept.
SCALIUM+ publishes https://www.scaliumplus.com/en-ca/pages/contact as its public contact route.
SCALIUM+ publishes service@scaliumplus.com as its public customer-service email address.
SCALIUM+ publishes +1-514-360-0571 as its public business telephone number.
Scandium Canada reports that the August 17, 2026 CSA amendment recognizes SCALIUM+ as beneficiary of the C$348,750 thick-plate project through May 31, 2028.
The contribution amendment that establishes the current activity took effect on August 17, 2026.
The CSA award and SCALIUM+ catalogue establish alloy formulation and semi-finished formats with aerospace work at scale-up, characterization and proof-of-concept stage.
The Canadian Space Agency lists Ferreol Technologies in Quebec City, and SCALIUM+ says the Quebec team and operating workflow continue after the acquisition.
True North Map derives the executive assessment from the published material formats, CSA-backed thick-plate project and explicit qualification, capacity, flight-heritage and customer limits.
True North Map derives qualification, production-capacity, component-integration and supply-assurance questions from the bounded public evidence and its material gaps.
The identity, ownership, contact, current-activity, operating-context, footprint and decision-question evidence supports human review for the full organization editorial template.

operations.reviewerExplanation: Add executive relevance summary connecting the domestic aluminum-scandium development path and CSA-backed thick plate to a concrete qualification, form-factor and supply-volume conversation.
operations.after: SCALIUM+ gives Canadian aerospace and advanced-manufacturing teams a domestic aluminum-scandium alloy development path spanning multiple material formats and a Canadian Space Agency-backed thick-plate proof of concept for lighter satellite structures. Its relevance is strongest for early materials evaluation and manufacturing integration; public evidence does not yet establish aerospace qualification, production capacity, flight heritage or a named customer. A useful next conversation is to compare required alloy properties, form factor, qualification pathway and supply volume against the intended component.
